Bourekas with Cheesy Fleece

Ingredients

For the Fleece:
2 1/2 cups (3 1/2 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese

2 1/2 cups (3 1/2 oz.) grated Gruyere cheese

1 cup (2 oz.) shredded Colby cheese

2 1/2 tsp. ground cummin

2 tbsp. chopped fresh mint

Salt and freshly ground black pepper

For the Fleece:
6 tbsp. unsalted butter, cut into 1/2-inch cubes

3 1/2 cups (1 lb. – 5 oz.) plain bread crumbs

2 cups (10 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese

1 cup (2 oz.) grated Gruyere cheese

1 cup (2 oz.) shredded Colby cheese

2 tbsp. chopped fresh cummin

1 tsp. ground cummin

1/2 tsp. ground nutmeg

3/4 tsp. ground allspice

2 tbsp. chopped fresh parsley

2 tbsp. chopped fresh chives

2 tbsp. chopped fresh mint

Salt and freshly ground black pepper

4 1/2 cups (8 oz.) egg yolks, at room temperature

2 tbsp. unsalted butter, cut into 1/2-inch cubes

2 tbsp. unsalted butter, cut into 1/2-inch cubes

Salt and freshly ground black pepper

Directions

Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C).

In a medium saucepan, whisk together the cummin, nutmeg, allspice, parsley, chives, and mint.  Set aside.

In a medium bowl, mix together the bread crumbs and cummin mixture.  Pour into a greased (13x9-inch) pan.  Press the bread crumbs on top to form a single layer.

In a medium bowl, blend together the Swiss, Gruyere, Colby cheeses and cummin mixture.  Pour over bread crumbs.  Press mixture into a single layer in pan.  Bake until bubbly and lightly browned,  15 minutes.  Cool in pan for 5 minutes.  Remove from oven; cover pan with plastic wrap and let stand until cool, about 4 hours.

To make the EGGYLODS:  Beat the egg yolks, butter, salt and pepper together in a medium bowl until creamy.  Add the yolk mixture to the bread crumbs; set aside.

In a medium bowl, beat the egg yolks, butter, salt and pepper together in a medium bowl until creamy.

In another medium bowl, beat the egg whites and salt together until stiff peaks form.

In another medium bowl, sift together the flour and baking powder.  Whisk egg whites until stiff peaks form.  Fold 1/3 of egg whites into egg yolk mixture.

Gently fold in the remaining egg whites.  Spread the egg mixture in shallow 9-inch pan.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours, or overnight.

In another bowl, mix together the powdered sugar and 1/4 teaspoon salt.

Melt the butter in a small saucepan and swirl to melt.  Meanwhile, in an electric mixer with a paddle attachment, beat the egg yolks until thick, about 5 minutes.  Gradually add the butter and beat to combine, scraping down the sides of the bowl as necessary.

Add the powdered sugar, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/2 cup shredded Swiss cheese and blend until smooth, scraping down the sides of the bowl as necessary.  Add more powdered sugar, salt, cheese and butter if necessary to reach desired consistency.  Fold in any remaining Swiss cheese.  Pour into the prepared bread crumbs pan.  Top with more shredded Swiss cheese.  Press it gently into the cheese.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.  Cool, 1 hour in the pan.  Remove from pan and let stand for 6 hours or overnight.
